description: This file provides help content and HTML rendering functions for the SuiteCRM installation process, including multiple help steps and a help menu.

classes.name: HelpItem
classes.description: A class representing a help item with associated field, title, and text.

methods.name: help_menu_html
methods.description: Generates HTML for the main help menu with links to different help steps.

methods.name: format_help_items
methods.description: Formats an array of HelpItem objects into an HTML table.

methods.name: help_step_1_html
methods.description: Generates HTML content for the first help step, including PHP environment checks.

methods.name: help_step_2_html
methods.description: Generates HTML content for database configuration help, with placeholder 'TODO' texts.

methods.name: help_step_3_html
methods.description: Generates HTML content for site configuration help, with placeholder 'TODO' texts.

methods.name: help_step_4_html
methods.description: Generates HTML content for installation step help, with placeholder 'TODO' text.

methods.name: help_step_5_html
methods.description: Generates HTML content for registration help, with placeholder 'TODO' text.
